texte: In the schoolyard boys race each other on all fours, hands and feet on the ground like bears, in a game of leaps and scrambles.
notes: 'on all fours' (posture idiom, no referent) is rendered by hands and feet on the ground; the bears of the simile are not depicted (non_affirme); 'each other' is a reciprocal pronoun folded into the boys. The action nouns 'leaps' and 'scrambles' are also entities, which receive the 'of' relations.

texte: In the schoolyard boys race each other walking on their hands, legs straight up in the air, in a game of tricks.
notes: 'tricks' (stunts) has no usual corresponding verb, so the noun is kept as predicate. 'tricks' is also an entity, which receives the 'of' relation.

texte: In the schoolyard a boy is down on the ground; whether he has fallen or is playing cannot be told.
notes: The two exclusive hypotheses (fallen / playing) are events marked possible and listed as alternatives.

texte: Depuis le pont d'un navire en détresse, un marin tire une fusée de signalisation qui monte dans la nuit en une traînée rouge.
notes: 'en détresse' is kept as a property of the ship (a state, not a depicted referent); 'en une traînée rouge' links the rocket to the form it takes.

texte: Depuis le pont d'un navire en détresse, un marin agite des pavillons de signalisation pour appeler à l'aide.
notes: 'pour appeler à l'aide' is the purpose of waving the flags; the guide has no purpose relation, so it is a plain event of the sailor.

texte: Depuis le pont d'un navire, une lueur rouge monte dans la nuit ; on ne sait si c'est une fusée ou un incendie.
notes: The glow's two possible identities are exclusive alternatives; no coref is written with the glow since neither identity is affirmed.

texte: A prisoner in chains sits on straw in a dungeon cell behind a barred door, while the jailer turns the key in the lock.
A prisoner in chains kneels on a scaffold in the square, while the executioner raises his sword above him.
notes: 'him' is resolved to the prisoner by meaning, not to the nearest preceding mention (the executioner).

texte: A man sits on straw beside a barred window; the room could be a cell or a stable.
notes: The room's two possible identities are exclusive alternatives (possible); no coref with the room since neither is affirmed.

texte: Une femme debout laisse pendre son bras droit, tendu vers le sol, la main ouverte le long du corps.
notes: 'debout' is an adjective, hence a property; the hand and body are the woman's (inalienable possession read from the definite article).

texte: Une femme debout lève son bras droit, tendu vers le ciel, la main ouverte au-dessus de la tête.
Une femme debout, enveloppée dans un grand manteau qui cache ses bras.
A traveller lies frozen to death in the snow beside the road, frost on his beard and his lantern gone out.
notes: 'frozen' is a resulting-state participle (property); 'death' is an action noun (die) of which the traveller is the experiencer.

texte: A traveller lies dead of heatstroke in the scorching desert beside the road, his water-flask empty.
notes: r1 'dead of heatstroke' is a causal 'of', not possession; the guide has no cause relation.

texte: A traveller lies motionless in the snow beside the road; he may simply be resting.
Un portefaix qui soulevait un lourd tonneau s'effondre, plié de douleur par une hernie soudaine ; ses compagnons le soutiennent et il se relève, blessé mais vivant.
notes: 'plié ... par une hernie' is a passive brought back to the active (hernia agent); the cause 'de douleur' is not annotated as a relation; 'le' is resolved to the porter by meaning.

texte: Un portefaix qui soulevait un lourd tonneau s'effondre, foudroyé par une rupture du cœur ; ses compagnons se découvrent devant son corps sans vie.
notes: The action noun 'rupture' is both an event (rompre) and an entity, the entity being agent of 'foudroyé'; 'sans vie' is a negated entity, like 'without any instrument'.

texte: Un portefaix est assis près d'un lourd tonneau, la main sur le ventre.
notes: 'est assis' is a posture of the whole person, written as an event.

texte: A little girl grins to show the gap where her milk tooth has just come out, holding the tiny tooth in her palm.
A little boy grins to show the gap where his milk tooth has just come out, holding the tiny tooth in his palm.
A little girl keeps her lips pressed together and holds something tiny in her closed fist.
notes: 'something' is an indefinite pronoun that resumes nothing; it is kept as an entity because it is the only mention of the held object.

texte: Une femme nue est étendue de tout son long sur le flanc gauche, la tête appuyée sur son bras replié.
notes: 'de tout son long' (full length) has no referent and qualifies the lying posture; whole-body posture is an event, body-part states (appuyée, replié) are properties.

texte: Un homme nu est étendu de tout son long sur le flanc gauche, la tête appuyée sur son bras replié.
notes: 'de tout son long' (full length) has no referent and qualifies the lying posture.

texte: Une femme est étendue sur un lit, sous un drap qui ne permet pas de voir si elle repose sur le dos ou sur le flanc.
notes: Only the side (back or flank) is the content of the indirect question; resting itself is implied by 'est étendue', so v4 is left affirmed.

texte: Psyche stands by a river where the whispering reeds have told her to wait; she gathers the tufts of golden wool left by the fierce sheep on the briars.
notes: The reeds' telling (present perfect, prior to the scene) is narrated rather than shown, hence portee source; 'her' is resolved to Psyche by meaning.

texte: Psyche stands by a river where the whispering reeds have told her to wait, while a swarm of ants sorts a heap of mixed grain for her.
notes: 'for her' (beneficiary) is written as destinataire; the reeds' telling is prior narration (portee source).

texte: Psyche stands alone by a river among the reeds, lost in thought.
notes: 'lost in thought' is an idiomatic state kept whole as a property, 'thought' not being a depicted referent.

texte: L'arche de Noé flotte paisiblement sur une immense étendue d'eau calme ; aucun noyé, aucune maison engloutie n'est visible.
notes: The manner adverb 'paisiblement' has no slot in the schema (events carry no properties); 'n'est visible' is a figuration verb, so the negation goes to the entities.

texte: L'arche de Noé flotte au loin, minuscule, sur une immense étendue d'eau ; au premier plan, des noyés et des maisons englouties occupent toute la vue.
notes: 'au loin' (in the distance) has no referent noun; it is carried only by the ark being tiny and opposed to the foreground.

texte: L'arche de Noé flotte sur les eaux ; le bas du tableau, où apparaissait peut-être la terre submergée, est perdu.
notes: 'apparaissait' is a figuration verb (no event); the relative 'où' is rendered by 'dans'; the submerged land is only possibly depicted, in a part of the painting now lost.
